finding: The upper diameter bound proposed for Kähler manifolds is not contradicted. Its conjectured equality-only-product clause fails on all balanced complex Grassmannians Gr_C(k,2k), k>=2.
limitations: The proposed universal Ricci-lower-bound diameter upper inequality is not proved or disproved. All metric factors refer to the intrinsic Plucker trace metric, not ambient projective distance; no complete equality-case classification is claimed.

scope: Complex Grassmannians Gr_C(k,N), k>=2 and N>=2k, with their Plucker-induced metric normalized by Ric(g)=g.
title: Balanced Grassmannians defeat the proposed Kähler diameter equality rigidity
